title.narrative: Maldives - Pension and Social Protection Administration

description.narrative: Revised PDO: to support the implementation of the National Pension Act, to strengthen institutional capacity of key agencies responsible for implementing the National Pension Act, and to develop the processes and platforms required for the delivery of social protection programs.

The development objective of the Pension and Social Protection Administration Project for Maldives is to support the establishment of a new pension authority and strengthening capacity at existing institutions of the recipient in order to effectively implement a new pension system and to provide a platform for additional social protection programs. There are two components to the project. The first component of the project is strengthening capacity for implementing the new pension program. This component will have three sub-components: (a) strengthening capacity for policy analysis and legal framework; (b) institution and capacity building for project implementation; and (c) co-financing for the Public Accounting System (PAS). The second component of the project is public awareness campaign provision of technical advisory services, goods, and training to the Ministry of Health and Family (MOHF) to design and implement an overall public information campaign to educate members of the new pension system on the objectives and mechanisms of the system including improving awareness of: 1) employers on their contributory obligations; 2) workers on their rights and benefits; and 3) senior citizens on the mechanism for claiming basic pension.

comment.narrative: All qualitative milestones have been achieved. Since the inception of the project 476 targeted information sessions have been conducted and 30,844 people have attended the sessions. The information sessions have been conducted in atolls, resorts, schools and colleges etc. In addition to information sessions, the project has leveraged mass media such as TV and Radio talk shows (217 times since the inception) and other channels such as newspaper articles, leaflets and sponsorship of events to raise public awareness were also carried out. Its website regularly publishes key indicators of the pension program (http://www.pension.gov.mv/stats/) and the MRPS members can access to their Retirement Saving Account online.

title.narrative: Development and implementation of new process for annuitization in MRPS.

target.value: Policy on annuitization evaluated by the MPAO Board.

comment.narrative: MPAO has developed in-house phased withdrawal provisions for MRPS pensioners. The options on annuitization have been explored and discussed by the MPAO Board. However after evaluating various annuitization options against the benefit and the cost to MRPS members as well as the regulatory environment, the MPAO Board has decided not to change to annuitization in the short run and the policy will be re-evaluated every two years.

actual.value: An In-house phased withdrawal provisions developed; annuitization options explored but it was decided it was not viable given the prevailing market conditions.

title.narrative: Development of options and piloting of new approach to targeting of social benefits

target.value: New targeting system full implemented for at least one social protection program.

comment.narrative: After evaluating various targeting options, a targeting method involving both cross-verifying income and asset ownership against administrative database and a Proxy-Means-Test poverty score calculation was adopted. The processes for implementation of  this targeting method was piloted and applied to new Single Parent Allowance applicants. The Government has decided to apply this method to all electricity subsidy beneficiaries.
